name: Stock pot
description: A tall stainless steel pot with a thick aluminium base and a loop handle each side. Holds about 12 litres.
notes: 260 mm across and 244 mm tall with a rolled rim, a 10 mm aluminium base disc and riveted loop handles, 304 mm across the handles. cooking carries the reference's cooking and boiling qualities. CHECK VOLUME and longest side: the box includes the handles and the open mouth; the pot body matches the reference's 12.7 L and 250 mm. The makeshift pressure cooker variant shares this model for now, though its clamped lid is a distinct state that would deserve its own model.

name: Plastic tumbler
description: A clear acrylic drinking tumbler with a heavy base. Hard to break.
notes: 110 mm tall, 80 mm across the mouth, holding about 260 ml. containing follows the other drinking vessels. CHECK VOLUME: the reference volume is the solid cup, the box includes its hollow. The tile draws the clear plastic as opaque.

name: Wine glass
description: A thin glass bowl on a tall stem and a round foot.
notes: 200 mm tall with a tulip bowl 88 mm across and a 74 mm foot. containing follows the other drinking vessels. CHECK VOLUME: the box includes the bowl's hollow and the space round the stem. The tile draws the glass as opaque. Fragile glass has no content field here.

name: Envelope
description: A long white paper envelope with a gummed flap.
notes: Lying flat, the model is 2 mm thick, the finest voxel grain; the paper itself is a fraction of that. A 241 by 105 mm business envelope lying flap up. The reference calls it a container for letters; holding one letter or a few paper items needs a container block the drafts leave to the integration, since a paper pocket this small has no grid precedent.

name: Gift card
description: A plastic card worth credit at a shop that no longer trades.
notes: 86 by 54 mm, bank-card size, in red with a white printed band and a gold logo patch. 2 mm thick, the finest voxel grain; a real card is under 1 mm.

name: Greeting card
description: A folded card with a printed picture on the front and a message inside.
notes: 177 by 127 mm, standing half open as a tent so it reads as a card rather than a sheet, with a blue printed panel and a red heart. CHECK VOLUME: the box is the open tent; folded flat it is near the reference's volume. Reading its message would need a readable-text field like the game's notes.

name: Letter
description: A handwritten letter on a single sheet, addressed to someone else.
notes: Lying flat, the model is 2 mm thick, the finest voxel grain; the paper itself is a fraction of that. One A4 sheet, 297 by 210 mm, lying flat face up with lines of writing. CHECK VOLUME follows from the 2 mm floor. Its text would be world-authored, read like the game's notes.

name: Postcard
description: A picture postcard of green hills under a blue sky. The back is for writing.
notes: Lying flat, the model is 2 mm thick, the finest voxel grain; the paper itself is a fraction of that. 152 by 102 mm, lying picture up with a white border. CHECK VOLUME follows from the 2 mm floor and the raised print.
